confirm.title: Connect UREVO walking pad
confirm.description: Read workout telemetry from {address}. Setup will not start, stop, reset, or change treadmill speed.

abort.already_configured: This walking pad is already configured.
abort.no_devices_found: No URTM041 walking pad is visible. Power it on without starting the belt and close its phone app.
abort.not_supported: This model is not supported by this experimental integration.

init.title: Manual treadmill controls
init.description: Leave controls disabled until telemetry has been checked against the console. Start resumes the treadmill's stored speed; the speed-change limit cannot constrain that stored starting speed. Keep the physical remote accessible. Arm expires after 60 seconds or one action; reconnecting clears it. Bluetooth Stop is not an emergency stop.

error.invalid_options: Enter a finite speed between 0.5 and 6.4 km/h.
